name: Noel
source:
An angel with a firm character, who works dilligently every day...
Or so one thought but contrarily, wants to make the beloved protagonist hers, who is able to use the God's lotus pond. 
While planning evil schemes to do so, she is sending damp and lukewarm gazes every day.

"Ah.. Were you surprised by my angel-ness? Fufu, it is fine to be honest!"
